## Description

What this document says, or what changed in it.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New document
- [ ] Correction — something was wrong
- [ ] Update — something changed in the system
- [ ] Status change (met / implemented / superseded / abandoned)
- [ ] Repository organisation

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the directory's `TEMPLATE.md`
- [ ] Status is stated where the template asks for it, including when
      the answer is "not met" or "proposed"
- [ ] Claims are checkable, or explicitly flagged as not
- [ ] Measurements carry the command or method that produced them
- [ ] Facts are linked rather than copied from another document
- [ ] Links resolve

## If this corrects a recorded measurement

- [ ] The document says the old value was wrong, rather than quietly
      replacing it — somebody acted on the previous number
- [ ] The new value's evidence is included

## If this changes a decision

- [ ] The reason for the change is in the document, not only in this PR
